Quando dicimus: Militibus sunt ducenti Taleri
dati, significatur,tota cohorte non nisi ducentos Ta-

Quid est Tertia Declinatio?
Tertia Declinatio est, cujus Nominativus singula-
ris definit in er,vel es,vel is, vel e, Genitivus Nomina-
tivo parisyllabus in is, Dativus in i. Si Tertia Decli-
natio ob imparisyllabum Dativum pluralem impa-
risyllaba appellanda est: sequitur praecedentes De-
clinationes etiam ob imparisyllabum Genitivum plu-
ralem esse imparisyllabas appellandas. Atqui hae im-
parisyllabae non vocantur. Ergo nec illa.

page.notes: Blackletter words (German glosses such as "bauch", "fuchs", "hundertfacht", "tausentfacht", "einfacht", "zweyfacht", "dreyfacht", "einfaltig", "zweyfaltig", "dreyfaltig", "hunderfaltig", "tausendfaltig", "tausentfaltig", "dem", "den", "des", "der", "Taleri", "Taleros", "Militibus") are set in black letter; their exact letters are partly uncertain, and some are marked [?] where the scan is unclear. Printed "Duplus"/"Duplex" glosses and "ducenti" read as printed. The line "Quando dicimus" is set in roman with a German gloss. Possible printing errors: "Quadruplex"/"Quintuplex" as printed; "Hic venter, der bauch" and "Hunc vetrem" (for "ventrem") are printed as shown. Some words are printed with a superscript or illegible strokes and were read as best possible. The head "Quaenam appellantur multiplicativa?" has an underline in the scan (a rule under the heading), not transcribed.
